prompt: Use Spectrum 2-3: page #FBF9FA, text #2D211F, accent #86851D, secondary surface #E7EFE8, text on accent #111111. Use body 16px, heading 48px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Set headings in Libre Baskerville and reading text in Work Sans; traditional serif with flexible sans reading text. Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Composition: Large event title, date and venue, then an unframed program table and direct booking action. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
